data.title: bn-4gsg: profile tool binding matches approved manifest on identity not path
data.description: Fix impossible full-dict equality (incl. relocatable path) between runtime profile-tool binding and the source-approved tools manifest. prepare-build relocates base tools into the prepared root; match on identity (sha256, executable_mode, comm) like the runner's load_prepared does. Fixture models the relocation as a regression guard. Tests: test_profile_adapters 46/46, runner 163/163, verifier 187/187, evaluator SELF_TEST_PASS.

data.reason: APPROVED. Verified: (1) matches the runner's canonical load_prepared reconciliation exactly — approved manifest compared on (sha256, executable_mode, comm), path excluded because prepare-build relocates base tools into the prepared root; (2) full equality with prepared_tools retained (runtime binding is built from prepared.tools, paths match); (3) executable_mode 0o555 pin retained (tools are pinned write-stripped copies); (4) fixture now models base->prepared relocation so path-equality regression is caught. open_findings=0
